在这最后一课，我们会看到神信实地对待一个因祖先犯罪而饱受恶果的民族。这一课不但讲到百姓被掳到巴比伦的日子，也讲到他们分三次回归应许之地的事情；再次显明神奇妙的怜悯和恩典。现在让我们开始这最后一课吧！

In this final lesson, we will see God's faithfulness to a nation suffering the consequences of their ancestors' sins. This lesson covers not only the people's captivity in Babylon but also their three-part return to the Promised Land, once again demonstrating God's amazing mercy and grace. Let's begin this final lesson!

 

 

第 91 步  70 年

Step 91​   70 years

动作：走到巴比伦，竖起七只手指  

Action: Walk to Babylon and raise seven fingers

走到巴比伦的位置，然后伸出 7 个手指头，说：“70 年”。

Walk to the location of Babylon, then stretch out 7 fingers and say: " 70 years " .

年份：主前 586~539 年  中国历史：春秋时代（孔子出生）

Year: BC 586~539 Year   Chinese History: Spring and Autumn Period (Birth of Confucius )

 

经文：  Scripture:

耶 25:8~9、11   所以万军之耶和华如此说：因为你们没有听从我的话，9 我必召北方

yeah 25:8-9 , 11    Therefore thus says the LORD of hosts: Because you have not obeyed my voice, 9 I will call the

的众族和我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击这地和这地的居民，并四围一切的国民。我要将他们尽行灭绝，以致他们令人惊骇、嗤笑……。11 这全地必然荒凉，令人惊骇。这些国民要服事巴比伦王七十年。

"I will bring all the tribes of Babylon and my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon against this land and its inhabitants and all the surrounding nations. I will utterly destroy them and make them an object of horror and hissing ... 11 This whole land will become a desolation and an object of horror. These nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.

 

问题：  question:

 根据耶利米书 25 章 11 节，以色列地将要怎样？而犹大国民要服事巴比伦王多久？

   According to Jeremiah 25 Chapter 11 What will happen to the land of Israel? And how long will the people of Judah serve the king of Babylon ?

 

解释：  explain:

神终于审判以色列民；但由于他大有怜悯，这个审判有一个期限，百姓被掳的日子不会超过 70 年。70 年是如何计算的呢？圣经学者持不同的看法。其中一个计算方法如下：

God finally judged the Israelites; but because of His great mercy, this judgment was limited to a time limit, and the people would be captive for no more than 70 days. How are 70 years calculated? Bible scholars hold different opinions. One method of calculation is as follows:

第一次被掳发生在主前 605 年，而第一次回归发生在主前 536 年，期间相隔 69

The first exile occurred in 605 BC and the first return occurred in 536 BC , a gap of 69 years.

年。然而，这种把两个年份相减的计算方法并不是绝对准确，请看看以下的例子：

Years. However, this method of subtracting two years is not absolutely accurate. Consider the following example:

 

·        例子一：2020 年 1 月 1 日 至 2021 年 12 月 30 日，这段期间几乎有 2 年

·         Example 1 : 20201 Month 1 Date to 2021 Year 12 Month 30 During this period, there were almost 2 Year

时间，但若仅把两个年份相减，就只得 1 年的时间；

time, but if you simply subtract two years, you only get 1 year;

 

·        例子二：2020 年 12 月 1 日至 2021 年 2 月 1 日，这段期间只有 2 个月的时

·         Example 2: From December 1, 2020 to February 1 , 2021 , there are only 2 months.

间，但若仅把两个年份相减，同样得出 1 年的时间。

 

However, if you simply subtract two years, you will also get 1 year.

因此，我们不用太过执着计算这 70 年的方法（也有圣经学者认为 70 年只是一个约数），我们要重视的是神信守他的应许，他的话一句也没有落空。

Therefore, we do not need to be too obsessed with calculating these 70 The year method ( some Bible scholars believe that 70 years is just an approximate number. What we should focus on is that God keeps His promises and not a single one of His words fails.

神通过先知耶利米，预言被掳的日子只限于 70 年（参耶 25:11~12）。在这 70 年

God prophesied through the prophet Jeremiah that the exile would be limited to 70 years ( see Jeremiah 25 : 11-12 ) .

中，发生了但以理书的戏剧性事件。请读但以理书（尤其第 1 至 7 章），看看人如何能在一个充满敌意和不信神的文化环境中为神而活。当但以理得知耶利米所预言的，于是在被掳日子将满时向神祷告（参但 9:1~3）。但以理书第 9 章是一篇祷告，内容相当特别！但以理代表他的同胞向神承认以色列人所犯的罪，并求神按着他与百姓所立的约，对他们施怜悯和恩典。

The dramatic events of Daniel occurred during the 1 to Chapter 7 , how can people live for God in a hostile and godless cultural environment. When Daniel learned of Jeremiah’s prophecy, he prayed to God at the end of his captivity (see Daniel 9 : 1-3 . Daniel 9 Chapter 1 is a prayer with quite unique content! Daniel confesses to God the sins of the Israelites on behalf of his compatriots and asks God to show them mercy and grace according to the covenant He made with His people.

耶利米预言以色列民会被掳 70 年，他也预言神会把他的百姓从被掳之地带回来

Jeremiah predicted that Israel would be exiled for 70 years. He also predicted that God would bring His people back from exile.

（参耶 32:6~40）。随着一些政治上的转变，神所应许的回归也逐渐实现。

( See Jeremiah 32 : 6-40 . ) With some political changes, God’s promised return gradually came to fruition.

你是否正在经历神的管教？要谨记神的管教只是一时，而非永远，为的是叫你的生命能够结出好果子来。而神给我们管教的同时，总是设了限度，好叫我们能忍受得住，现在就为此感谢主吧！

Are you experiencing God's discipline? Remember that it's temporary, not permanent, and is meant to produce good fruit in your life. When God disciplines us, He always sets limits so we can endure it. Thank the Lord for this now!

 

 

第 92 步  波斯帝国兴起

Step 92​   Rise of the Persian Empire

动作：走到波斯，双手慢慢升至肩部  

Action: Walk to Persia and slowly raise your hands to your shoulders

我们走到巴比伦帝国的东北边，然后作“兴起”的动作，这跟前面第 72 步“亚述帝国兴起”和第 79 步“巴比伦帝国兴起”的动作一样，双手掌心向上，由下往上升到肩膀的位置。

We walk to the northeast side of the Babylonian Empire and then make the " rise " movement, which is the same as the movement in step 72 " Rise of the Assyrian Empire " and step 79 " Rise of the Babylonian Empire " . With the palms facing up, rise from the bottom to the shoulder position.

年份：主前 540 年  中国历史：春秋时代

Year: BC 540 Year   Chinese History: Spring and Autumn Period

 

经文：  Scripture:

赛 45:1 我─耶和华所膏的古列；我搀扶他的右手，使列国降伏在他面前。我也要放松列王的腰带，使城门在他面前敞开，不得关闭。

Isaiah 45:1 I am Cyrus, the anointed of the Lord; I hold his right hand and subdue nations before him. I will loosen the belts of kings and open the gates before him; they will not be shut.

 

解释：  explain:

早在约 180 年前，神己经借先知以赛亚预言神会兴起波斯的古列王，使列国降伏在他面前，使他能征服列国。波斯帝国的兴起是这地区最大的政治转变。全盛时

As early as about 180 Years ago, God had prophesied through the prophet Isaiah that He would raise up King Cyrus of Persia and bring all nations under his rule, enabling him to conquer them. The rise of the Persian Empire was the greatest political change in the region.

 

 

期的波斯帝国，西起希腊，东至印度。波斯帝国位于巴比伦东北面，首都是书珊；这时巴比伦帝国已经明显衰落。在古列王统治下，波斯人先征服玛代，下一个目标就是巴比伦……。

The Persian Empire, stretching from Greece in the west to India in the east, was located northeast of Babylon, with its capital at Shushan. By this time, the Babylonian Empire was already in decline. Under the reign of King Cyrus, the Persians first conquered Media, and their next target was Babylon .

读以斯帖记和但以理书，你会发现圣经作者经常提及波斯和玛代，把两者拼在一起，以二者为一国。事实上。历史学家也把玛代人和波斯人交替使用。为何会这样？主前550 年，玛代军和波斯军打仗。

Reading the books of Esther and Daniel, you will find that the biblical authors frequently mention Persia and Media , combining the two as one nation. In fact, historians also use the terms Medes and Persians interchangeably. Why is this so? 550 B.C. In that year, the Medes and Persians fought a war.

图片来源：互联网  Image source: Internet

 

 

人数众多的玛代军反而被波斯打败。波斯王古列没有废除玛代国的国名，统一称为波斯，而是保留玛代这个国名，自立为玛代王，同时统治玛代和波斯，并且使二国的权利均等。因此，在被掳后的时期，圣经以波斯和玛代称呼这个新的国家。而这就是兴起中的波斯帝国。

The outnumbered Median army was defeated by Persia. King Cyrus of Persia, instead of abolishing the name of the Medes and unifying the nation as Persia, retained the name Media and proclaimed himself king of the Medes, ruling both Media and Persia simultaneously, with equal power in both. Therefore, in the post-exilic period, the Bible refers to this new nation as Persia and Media. This was the rise of the Persian Empire.

波斯原本的版图位于巴比伦与波斯湾之间，版图较大的玛代位于巴比伦的东北面，因此，做这一步的动作时，我们会站在巴比伦帝国的东北边。

The original territory of Persia was located between Babylon and the Persian Gulf, and the larger Media was located northeast of Babylon. Therefore, when doing this step, we will stand in the northeast of the Babylonian Empire.

 

 

第 93 步  征服巴比伦

Step 93​   Conquer Babylon

动作：右手握拳，向下击打左掌  

Action: Make a fist with your right hand and strike your left palm downwards

面向着巴比伦，动作跟“征服亚述”一样：右手握拳，向下击打左手的手掌。

Facing Babylon, the action is the same as in " Conquering Assyria " : make a fist with your right hand and strike the palm of your left hand downward.

年份：主前 539 年  中国历史：春秋时代

Year: BC 539 Year   Chinese History: Spring and Autumn Period

 

经文：  Scripture:

赛 13:19   巴比伦素来为列国的荣耀，为迦勒底人所矜夸的华美，必像神所倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉一样。

Isa 13:19 Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans' pride, will be like Sodom and Gomorrah, when God overthrew them.

 

问题：  question:

 根据以赛亚书 13 章 19 节，巴比伦国最终的结果是什么？

   According to Isaiah 13:19 , what was the final outcome for the Babylonian nation ?

解释：  explain:

波斯征服巴比伦，完全应验了先知以赛亚在差不多 180 年前所预言的（参赛

The Persian conquest of Babylon was a perfect fulfillment of the prophet Isaiah's prediction made almost 180 Predicted years ago ( participating

13:19~22，14:23，47:1~5）。以赛亚约在主前 720 年写下这些预言。但以理书第 5 章记载了当时在巴比伦境内发生的事情。

13 : 19-22 , 14:23 , 47 : 1-5 . Isaiah wrote these prophecies around 720 B.C. Daniel chapter 5 records what happened in Babylon at that time.

然而，要征服巴比伦谈何容易？下图是一幅按一比一比例复制的巴比伦城墙，

However, conquering Babylon was no easy task. The following image is a 1:1 replica of the Babylonian city walls.

 

 

可见巴比伦城的城墙多么坚固宏伟。考古学家更发现城墙的部分位置由双重结构所组成。在城墙前面有一道很阔的护城河。因此，巴比伦人一直相信没有任何国家可以攻破他们的城。

This demonstrates the strength and grandeur of Babylon's walls. Archaeologists have discovered that some sections of the walls consisted of a double structure. In front of the walls ran a vast moat . Consequently, the Babylonians always believed that no nation could conquer their city.

然而，神是至高者，他在人的国中掌权，要将国赐与谁就赐与谁，或立极卑微的人执掌国权。因此，他可以兴起当其时细小的波斯，使它征服玛代，再征服巴比伦。事实上，虽然但以理是亡国奴，对他而言，大势已去，可是，但以理书 10 次提到神是至高者，高过世上一切的君王，包括巴比伦王以及波斯王，因此神绝对能够成就他所发的预言和应许。

However, God is the Most High. He reigns supreme over human kingdoms, granting them to whomever He chooses, even placing the humblest of men in their stead. Therefore, He could raise up then-tiny Persia and enable it to conquer Media and then Babylon. In fact, although Daniel was a captive and his fate seemed hopeless, the Book of Daniel mentions God ten times as the Most High, superior to all earthly kings, including the kings of Babylon and Persia. Therefore, God is absolutely capable of fulfilling His prophecies and promises.

古列集结大军攻击巴比伦城。巴比伦人预计会被长期围困，所以储备了足够 20年使用的物资。另外，幼发拉底河由北而南流经这城，居民的水源也很充足。由于波斯军队无法攻破巴比伦城的城墙，巴比伦王伯沙撒就自以为很安全。

Cyrus assembled a massive army to attack Babylon. Anticipating a long siege, the Babylonians had stockpiled enough supplies to last 20 years. Furthermore, the Euphrates River flowed through the city from north to south, providing the inhabitants with an abundant water supply. Since the Persian army was unable to breach Babylon’s walls, King Belshazzar of Babylon felt secure.

 

但 5:25~28  所写的文字是：“弥尼，弥尼，提客勒，乌法珥新。”26 讲解是这样：

Daniel 5:25-28   The writing was: “ MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN. ” 26 And this is the interpretation:

弥尼，就是神已经数算你国的年日到此完毕。27 提客勒，就是你被称在天平里，显出你的亏欠。28 乌法珥新，就是你的国分裂，归与米底亚人和波斯人。（编注：米底亚人就是玛代人）

27 Tekel, you were weighed in the balances and found wanting. 28 Upharsin, your kingdom was divided and given to the Medes and Persians .

但 5:30  当夜，迦勒底王伯沙撒被杀。

Dan 5:30   That night Belshazzar, king of the Chaldeans, was killed.

有一天，也就是巴比伦被攻陷的那天，当时伯沙撒王为他的一千大臣设摆盛宴。他向神自高，使人把圣殿里的器皿拿来饮酒，并且赞美各个偶像，没有把荣耀归给掌管他气息和人生的神。神就审判他，预言巴比伦的年日已到尽期。在他们欢饮之际，忽然有人的指头在墙上写字。所写的字的内容和解释，就是我们刚才读的经文。他们当时并不知道波斯兵的行动。波斯军队在城北挖了一道运河，把幼发拉底河的河水引到附近一个湖里去。随着河水改道，护城河的河水水位渐渐下降。

One day, the day Babylon was conquered, King Belshazzar gave a great feast for a thousand of his nobles. He exalted himself to God, causing people to drink from the temple vessels and praise the idols instead of giving glory to the God who controls his breath and life. God judged him and prophesied that Babylon's days were over. As they reveled , a finger suddenly wrote on the wall. The words and their interpretation are the verses we just read. They were unaware of the Persian army's actions. The Persians had dug a canal north of the city, diverting the waters of the Euphrates River into a nearby lake. As the river was diverted, the water level of the moat gradually dropped.

 

当夜，波斯士兵展开行动，从水闸下面攻到城里去。当时巴比伦的领导层喝得酩酊大醉，对正在发生的一切仍懵然不知，自觉很安全，没有安排士兵守卫城墙。正因为这样，波斯人得以不战而胜，轻易攻陷这城。巴比伦城于主前 539 年沦陷。

That night, the Persian army launched an attack, advancing beneath the sluice gates and into the city. The Babylonian leadership, utterly drunk and unaware of what was happening, felt safe and unarmed, leaving no soldiers guarding the city walls. This allowed the Persians to easily capture the city without a fight. Babylon fell in 539 BC .

 

弟兄姊妹，我们也有一个敌人，所以我们务须警醒谨守，不能在自我放纵中打瞌睡。请看看神在帖撒罗尼迦前书 5 章 4 至 9 节给我们的吩咐：

Brothers and sisters, we too have an enemy, so we must be vigilant and sober, not falling asleep in self-indulgence. Consider God 's command to us in 1 Thessalonians 5 : 4-9 :

弟兄们，你们却不在黑暗里，叫那日子临到你们像贼一样。5 你们都是光明之子，都是白昼之子，我们不是属黑夜的，也不是属幽暗的；6 所以我们不要睡觉，像别人一样，总要警醒谨守。7 因为睡了的人是在夜间睡，醉了的人是在夜间醉。8 但我们既然属乎白昼，就应当谨守，把信和爱当作护心镜遮胸，把得救的盼望当作头盔戴上。

But you, brothers, are not in darkness, so that this day should overtake you like a thief. 5 You are all sons of light and sons of the day; we are not of the night or of darkness. 6 So let us not sleep, as others do , but let us watch and be sober. 7 For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night. 8 But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of the hope of salvation.

9 因为神不是预定我们受刑，乃是预定我们借着我们主耶稣基督得救。

9 For God has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

巴比伦王因为醉倒和没有警醒，让敌人不战而胜。同样，教会领袖也曾因为没有警醒而让敌人攻击群羊。故此，领袖们，让我们活得像白昼之子。我们不害怕撒但，但也不能忽视它；我们不害怕世界，但也不能忘记它的危险；我们相信靠着主耶稣基督可以得胜，但也不能忘记我们是在争战之中。让我们的心灵在基督里得享安息，但是也要穿上军装去打仗！我们务要警醒！要活得像白昼之子，不要因为带领群羊时不够自制和警醒而给敌人攻陷！因此，我们要常常警醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。

The king of Babylon, drunken and unwary, allowed his enemies to triumph without a fight. Similarly, church leaders, unwary, have allowed their enemies to attack their flocks. Therefore, leaders, let us live as sons of the day. We are not afraid of Satan, but we cannot ignore him. We are not afraid of the world, but we cannot forget its dangers. We believe in our victory through the Lord Jesus Christ, but we cannot forget that we are in a battle. Let our hearts rest in Christ, but we must also put on our armor for battle! We must be vigilant! Live as sons of the day, and do not allow our lack of self-control and vigilance in leading the flock to allow the enemy to defeat us! Therefore, we must always watch and pray, lest we fall into temptation.

 

 

第 94 步  回归

Step 94​   return

动作：双手向前伸出，走到以色列  

Action: Extend your hands forward and walk to Israel

动作跟第 25 步“进入以色列”一样：朝以色列的方向，双手向前方伸出，好像引导前面的道路，一直走到以色列那里。

The movements are the same as in step 25 , " Entering Israel " : toward the direction of Israel, stretch your hands forward as if guiding the way ahead, and walk all the way to Israel.

年份：主前 538 年  中国历史：春秋时代

Year: BC 538 Year   Chinese History: Spring and Autumn Period

 

经文：  Scripture:

耶 29:10   耶和华如此说：为巴比伦所定的七十年满了以后，我要眷顾你们，向你们成就我的恩言，使你们仍回此地。

Jeremiah 29:10 Thus says the LORD: When the seventy years appointed for Babylon are completed, I will visit you and  Fulfill my gracious words and bring you back here .

拉 1:1~3 波斯王古列元年，耶和华为要应验借耶利米口所说的话，就激动波斯王古列的心，使他下诏通告全国说：2“波斯王古列如此说：‘耶和华天上的神，已将天下万国赐给我，又嘱咐我在犹大的耶路撒冷，为他建造殿宇。3 在你们中间凡作他子民的，可以上犹大的耶路撒冷，在耶路撒冷重建耶和华以色列神的殿（只有他是神），

Ezra 1:1-3 In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill the word of the Lord through Jeremiah, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia so that he issued a proclamation throughout all his kingdom and put it in writing, saying, 2 “ Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: ‘ The Lord, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth and has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. 3 Anyone among you of his people may go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and rebuild the house of the Lord, the God of Israel (he is God ), which is in Jerusalem.

愿神与这人同在。  May God be with this man.

拉 6:3~4   古列王元年，他降旨论到耶路撒冷神的殿，要建造这殿为献祭之处……经费要出于王库……（参赛 44:28）

Ezra 6:3-4 In the first year of King Cyrus, he issued a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem: "Let it be built for sacrifice ... and its cost shall come from the royal treasury ..." (See also 44:28 )

 

问题：  question:

 为了要应验耶利米关乎 70 年被掳后可以回归的预言，神怎样做？  古列要在耶路撒冷做什么？古列叫所有作神子民的人做什么？

   In order to fulfill Jeremiah's statement about 70 What did God do about the prophecy of return after the captivity?    What did Cyrus want to do in Jerusalem? What did Cyrus want all of God’s people to do?

解释：  explain:

古列灭了巴比伦后，在同年就下旨让国内的犹大人，可以回归耶路撒冷，并且下令他们要重建圣殿，而建殿的费用由波斯国来支付。为何会这样？圣经说神激动

After Cyrus destroyed Babylon, he issued a decree in the same year allowing the people of Judah to return to Jerusalem and ordered them to rebuild the temple, with the cost of the temple to be paid by Persia. Why was this so? The Bible says that God stirred up

（唤醒）古列的心。为什么神要激动古列？因为耶和华要应验他借耶利米口所说的话：他们被掳 70 年，就可以回归。最特别的地方是古列鼓励他们重建圣殿。

Awakening Cyrus's heart. Why did God stir up Cyrus? Because the Lord was fulfilling the word He spoke through Jeremiah : After 70 years of captivity, they could return. Most significantly, Cyrus encouraged them to rebuild the temple.

古列并非真正相信耶和华，他这样宣告不是因为他相信神。事实上，古列所关注的，是在他帝国的四周建立起强大而对他效忠的缓冲国。此外，他让各属土的人民重返自己的国家，是期望帝国内各地的神祇，会在他的神彼勒和尼波面前为他祈祷；这才是他的真正动机。但神说他兴起古列是要成就他的计划（赛 45:13），正如箴言 21 章 1 节所说的：“王的心在耶和华手中，好像陇沟的水，随意流转。”

Cyrus did not truly believe in Jehovah, and his declaration was not based on faith in God. In fact, Cyrus was concerned with establishing strong, loyal buffer states around his empire. Furthermore, by allowing the people of the various territories to return to their own lands, he hoped that the local gods of the empire would pray for him before his gods, Bel and Nebo ; this was his true motive. Yet, God said he raised up Cyrus to fulfill his plan (Isaiah 45:13 ) , just as Proverbs 21: 1 says : " The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, like the rivers of water; he turns it wherever he will. "

古列是因为个人和政治的理由才吩咐犹太人返回耶路撒冷重建圣殿，虽然如此，但整件事的背后其实是神大能的手在掌管、引导和带领，让君王首领都按着神的旨意行事。

Cyrus ordered the Jews to return to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple for personal and political reasons. However, behind the whole thing was actually God's mighty hand that was controlling, guiding, and leading, allowing the kings and leaders to act according to God's will .

弟兄姊妹，不要因为自己国家的政治情况而沮丧。虽然国家领导人不一定认识神，但神会带领他们的心，使他的旨意和应许能够成就。神是万国之王；纵使地上万国现在并不承认这个事实，神仍是万国之王！你要做的，就是忠心地为领导人和国家祷告，求神为国家的好处而作工。

Brothers and sisters, do not be discouraged by the political situation in your country. Although national leaders may not know God, He will guide their hearts so that His will and promises can be fulfilled. God is King of all nations; even if the nations of the earth do not recognize this fact now, God is still King of all nations! All you need to do is pray faithfully for your leaders and your country, asking God to work for the good of your country.

神的应许实现了！犹大人终于回归圣地。尽管神因他百姓的罪和拜偶像而惩罚他们，但他没有忘记他们。神兴起古列并激动他的心，使他向全国宣告，他要为耶和华重建圣殿，而且费用由他来负责。所有以色列人都可以返回耶路撒冷。

God's promise had been fulfilled! The people of Judah had finally returned to the Holy Land. Although God punished his people for their sins and idolatry, he had not forgotten them. God raised up Cyrus and stirred his heart to declare to the nation that he would rebuild the temple to the Lord and that he would pay for it. All Israel could return to Jerusalem.

然而，有一点值得留意，第一次回归的人数只有五万，但根据历史记载，被掳到巴比伦的以色列人人数为四十万至六十万左右。那到底是什么原因使大部分以色列人都不愿回归呢？犹太历史学家约瑟夫在《犹太古史》指出，大部分犹太人宁愿留在巴比伦不肯回归的原因有两个：

However, it is worth noting that only 50,000 returned in the first exile, while historical records indicate that the number of Israelites taken captive to Babylon was approximately 400,000 to 600,000. So, what exactly prevented the majority of Israelites from returning? In his Antiquities of the Jews, the Jewish historian Josephus points out two reasons why most Jews preferred to remain in Babylon rather than return:

 他们不肯放弃巴比伦的家业，不想在荒凉了几十年的耶路撒冷重头开始。

   They were unwilling to give up their Babylonian heritage and did not want to start over in Jerusalem, which had been desolate for decades.

 因为他们害怕回到耶路撒冷后，要过严谨的生活；他们在巴比伦已住了几十年，不受神的律法约束，可以自由任意而行；他们已习惯了巴比伦的生活，那与回归耶路撒冷后的生活简直是天渊之别；对他们而言，回归就是自讨苦吃。

   Because they were afraid of having to live a strict life after returning to Jerusalem; they had lived in Babylon for decades, not bound by God's laws and able to do whatever they wanted; they had become accustomed to life in Babylon, which was a world of difference from life after returning to Jerusalem; for them, returning was asking for trouble.

总括来说，大部分不愿回归的犹大人都不想为作为神子民的身份付代价，也就不想离开巴比伦。

In summary, most of the Jews who were unwilling to return did not want to pay the price for their identity as God's people, and therefore did not want to leave Babylon.

弟兄姊妹，如果我们要重建我们跟神的关系，我们必须改变自己的生活，离开那些拦阻我们追求长进的事情，并为此付上代价。

Brothers and sisters, if we want to rebuild our relationship with God, we must change our lives, leave those things that hinder our pursuit of growth, and pay the price for it.

 

 

第 95 步  重建圣殿和城墙

Step 95​   Rebuilding the temple and city walls

动作：双臂交叠在胸前，右左拳头先后立  

Action: Cross your arms in front of your chest, raise your right fist and left fist

这一步的动作，跟“拆毁圣殿和城墙”的动作，是相反的。两手握拳，左右手臂交叠放在胸前，说“重建”，随即把叠在上面的右手立起来，说“圣殿”，然后把左手立起来，说“和城墙”。（这句话要与动作配合，连续不断地讲出来。）

The movements in this step are the opposite of those in " Tear down the temple and the city wall . " Make fists with your hands, fold your arms over your chest, and say " Rebuild ." Then, raise your right hand, which is folded over the top, and say " Temple . " Then, raise your left hand and say " and the city wall . " ( This phrase should be said continuously, in coordination with the movements. )

年份：主前 537~444 年  中国历史：春秋、战国时代

Year: BC 537~444 Year   Chinese History: Spring and Autumn Period and Warring States Period

 

经文：  Scripture:

拉 6:14~15  犹大长老因先知哈该和易多的孙子撒迦利亚所说劝勉的话，就建造这殿……。15 大利乌王第六年，亚达月初三日，这殿修成了。

pull 6:14-15 The elders of Judah built this house in response to the exhortations of the prophet Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo . 15 The house was completed on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of King Darius.

尼 6:15   以禄月二十五日，城墙修完了，共修了五十二天。

Ni 6:15    The wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul. It took fifty-two days to build it .

问题：  question:

 根据以上两段经文，回归的人完成了哪两项修建工作？

   According to the two passages above, what two construction projects were completed by the returnees?

 

解释：  explain:

第 90 步说“拆毁圣殿和城墙”。它们被毁，是因为百姓行恶、叛逆神；现在得以重建，是因为百姓悔改、信靠神。

Step 90 says, “ Tear down the temple and the city wall . ” They were destroyed because the people were evil and rebelled against God; now they are being rebuilt because the people repent and trust in God.

我们在上一步已经指出，回归的人数大概占总人口的百分之十。由于回归的人信靠的是神，不再是耶路撒冷城和圣殿，因此，神不仅让犹大人重回国土，还让他们把代表神与他们同在的两个主要象征重建起来，就是耶路撒冷城和城里的圣殿。他们得花很大的工夫才能建成这殿和城墙，但若没有神的灵动工，就肯定不能建成。

As we noted in the previous step, the number of returnees accounted for approximately 10 percent of the total population. Because the returnees placed their trust in God, rather than in Jerusalem and the temple, God not only allowed the people of Judah to return to their land but also allowed them to rebuild two key symbols of God's presence: Jerusalem and the temple within. Building this temple and the city walls required considerable effort, but without the work of God's Spirit, it would have been impossible.

罪恶、无知、叛逆和漠不关心同样足以拆毁教会；顺服、悔改和信靠神的心却可以建立教会。你的教会正在被建立还是遭拆毁？你可能会说它正被异端拆毁，但这其实只是病征而已。如果我们身体强壮，就能抵抗不同类型的病毒和细菌；但假如我们身体孱弱，各类病毒和细菌就会乘虚而入，令我们病倒。异端和其他外在影响就像病毒一般，除非教会本身有所不足，否则异端无法拆毁教会。有什么事情会令教会软弱，以致别的影响可以乘虚而入，侵害教会？又有什么能使教会壮大？你可以怎样使教会强健起来？你如何协助教会“补补身体”？

Sin, ignorance, rebellion, and apathy can also tear down a church; obedience, repentance, and trust in God can build it up. Is your church being built up or torn down? You might say it's being torn down by heresy, but that's just a symptom. If we're physically strong, we can resist different types of viruses and bacteria; but if we're weak, all sorts of viruses and bacteria can take advantage and make us sick. Heresy and other external influences are like viruses; they can't tear down a church unless there's something wrong with the church itself. What weakens a church, allowing other influences to take advantage and harm it? And what strengthens a church? How can you strengthen your church? How can you help the church " repair its body " ?

 

 

第 96 步  三次回归

Step 96​   Three regressions

动作：竖起三只手指  

Action: Hold up three fingers

右手竖起三个手指头。  Raise three fingers on your right hand.

 

解释：  explain:

我们知道犹大百姓分三次被掳到巴比伦（参第 86 至 89 步）。他们回归犹大也同样分三次。神把百姓带到异地，现在他要把他们带回来。每次回归，都有一项重建

We know that the people of Judah were taken captive to Babylon three times ( see steps 86-89 ) . Their return to Judah was also three times. God had taken the people to a foreign land, and now He was bringing them back. Each time they returned, there was a rebuilding process.

的工程，分别是：  The projects are:

        重建圣殿（主前 536 年开始）；

         Rebuilding of the Temple ( began in 536 BC ;

        重建圣民（主前 458 年）；

         Rebuilding the Holy People ( 458 B.C. Year;

        重建城墙（主前 444 年）。

         Rebuilding the city walls ( 444 B.C. Year.

在这三次回归和重建中，神分别兴起了三位领袖来领导重建的工作。以下三步会分别谈到这三位带领余民回到耶路撒冷重建圣殿、圣民和城墙的领袖。

During these three returns and rebuilding efforts, God raised up three leaders to lead the work of reconstruction. The following three steps will discuss these three leaders who led the remnant back to Jerusalem to rebuild the temple, the holy people, and the city walls.

 

 

第 97 步  所罗巴伯

Step 97​   Zerubbabel

动作：指着第一只手指接续前一步的动作，  

Action: Point to the first finger to continue the previous step.

右手仍然竖起三个手指头，左手指着第一只手指，说：“所罗巴伯”

With three fingers still raised on his right hand, he pointed to the first finger with his left hand and said, " Zerobabel "

年份：主前 537 年  中国历史：春秋时代

Year : 537 BC   Chinese History: Spring and Autumn Period

  

经文：  Scripture:

该 1:14   耶和华激动犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下之百姓的心；他们就来为万军之耶和华他们神的殿作工。

Hag. 1:14 Then the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and of the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of hosts their God.

拉 3:2   约萨达的儿子耶书亚和他的弟兄众祭司，并撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯与他的弟兄，都起来建筑以色列神的坛，要照神人摩西律法书上所写的，在坛上献燔祭。

Ezra 3:2 Then Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers the priests , and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his brothers, stood up and built the altar of the God of Israel to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the Law of Moses the man of God.

 

问题：  question:

 根据哈该书 1 章 14 节，神激动谁作工？他们来为什么作工？

   According to Haggai 1:14 , who did God inspire to work? Why did they come to work?

 

解释：  explain:

所罗巴伯是约雅斤的孙子；约雅斤就是那位被废而蒙羞的君王（参拉 3:2;代上 3:17~19）。还记得这个王吗？他十八岁即位，登基仅三个月就被废掉，并被掳至巴比  伦（参王下24:8；结19:5~9）。但30 多年后，他却获得巴比伦王恩待（参王下25:27~30）。他虽然一无可取，但神却拣选他的后裔带领百姓回归和展开重建的工作！所罗巴伯还是弥赛亚的祖先呢（参太 1:12）！我们的神真是满有恩典啊！

Zerubbabel was the grandson of Jehoiachin, the deposed and disgraced king ( cf. 3 : 2 ; 1 Chronicles 3 : 17-19 . Remember this king? He came to the throne at the age of 18, but was deposed after only three months on the throne and taken captive to Babylon.   ( See 2 Kings 24 : 8 ; Ezekiel 19 : 5-9 . Daniel 30 Many years later, he was favored by the king of Babylon ( see 2 Kings 25 : 27-30 ). Although he had nothing to recommend him, God chose his descendants to lead the people back and begin the work of reconstruction! Zerubbabel was also the ancestor of the Messiah ( see Matthew 1 :17-19) . 1:12 ) Our God is truly full of grace!

主前 536 年，所罗巴伯受命于古列，带领第一批百姓回归耶路撒冷（参拉 1~2）。他也成为犹大省的第一任省长。他率领大约 5 万人回去。他们去到犹大的时候，当然百废待兴。他们的家园是否需要重建？荒废了的田地是否需要重新开垦？当然需要。然而，第一批回归的人任务、使命不是重建家园、重建经济，而是重建圣殿，恢复献祭、恢复跟神的关系。所罗巴伯最先重建的是祭坛，并且献上燔祭，代表他们愿意完完全全地把自己奉献给神。

536 BC In 166 BC, Zerubbabel was commissioned by Cyrus to lead the first group of people back to Jerusalem ( see Ezra 1-2 ) . He also became the first governor of the province of Judah. He led about 5 Ten thousand people returned. When they arrived in Judah, there was certainly much to be done. Did their homes need to be rebuilt? Did the abandoned fields need to be reclaimed? Of course they did . However, the task and mission of the first group of returnees was not to rebuild their homes or the economy, but to rebuild the temple, restore sacrifices, and restore their relationship with God. Zerubbabel first rebuilt the altar and offered a burnt offering, representing their willingness to dedicate themselves completely to God.

教会想复兴，首要要做的就是，重建、更新每一个弟兄姊妹跟神的关系，这个没有做好，其他就不用说了。我们个人的生命亦然。停顿了、后退了、在吃老本，那就须要再次重建我们跟神的关系，並且再次把自己的身体献上当作活祭。

If the church wants to be revived, the first thing it must do is rebuild and renew every brother and sister's relationship with God. If this isn't done well, nothing else matters. The same is true for our individual lives. If we've stagnated, retreated, or are resting on our laurels, then we need to rebuild our relationship with God and once again offer our bodies as a living sacrifice.

 

 

第 98 步  以斯拉

Step 98​   Ezra

动作：指着第二只手指  

Action: Pointing the second finger

右手仍然竖起三个手指头，左手指着第二只手指，说“以斯拉”。

With three fingers still raised on the right hand, point to the second finger with the left hand and say " Ezra " .

年份：主前 458 年  中国历史：孔子死于主前 479 年

Year: BC 458 Year   Chinese History: Confucius died in 479 BC

 

一、以斯拉的背景  1. Ezra’s Background

经文：  Scripture:

拉 7:6、8、10 这以斯拉从巴比伦上来，他是敏捷的文士，通达耶和华─以色列神所赐摩西的律法书。王允准他一切所求的，是因耶和华─他神的手帮助他。……8 王第七年五月，以斯拉到了耶路撒冷。……10 以斯拉定志考究遵行耶和华的律法，又将律例典章教训以色列人。

Ezra 7:6 , 8 , 10 This Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a skilled scribe, knowledgeable in the Law of Moses, which the Lord , the God of Israel, had given him. The king granted him all his request, because the hand of the Lord his God was on him. … 8 In the seventh year of the king , in the fifth month, Ezra arrived in Jerusalem. … 10 Ezra set his heart to study the Law of the Lord and to practice it, and to teach its statutes and laws in Israel.

 

问题：  question:

 在抵达耶路撒冷之前，以斯拉定志做什么？

   Before arriving in Jerusalem, what did Ezra resolve to do?

解释：  explain:

所罗巴伯带领第一批以色列人返回耶路撒冷。现在，以斯拉率领第二批以色列人回到那地，人数约为 2000 人，回归的详情记载在以斯拉记 7 章 11 至 26 节。为什么他会回归？圣经说那是因为耶和华他神的手帮助他──当时的波斯王亚达薛西派他去。所罗巴伯有王族血统，以斯拉则是祭司和文士（参拉 7:1、6、21）。他领导以色列人第二次的回归，并重建圣民。他是个什么人？他其实是大祭司的后裔。纵然在异地没有圣殿、祭坛，他仍然渴慕神的话。经文强调：他是个敏捷的文士，通达摩西五经。简单来说，他是一个熟读和熟悉圣经的人。经文也提到以斯拉立定心志做三件事：

Zerubbabel led the first group of Israelites back to Jerusalem. Now, Ezra led the second group of Israelites back to the land, with a total of about 2,000 people. The details of the return are recorded in Ezra 7 : 11-26 . Why did he return? The Bible says that it was because the hand of the Lord his God helped him - he was sent by Artaxerxes, the king of Persia at the time . Zerubbabel was of royal descent, and Ezra was a priest and scribe ( see Ezra 7:1 , 6 , 21 ) . He led the Israelites in their second return and rebuilt the holy people. Who was he? He was actually a descendant of the high priest. Even though there was no temple or altar in a foreign land, he still longed for the word of God. The scripture emphasizes that he was a scribe who was proficient in the Pentateuch. In short, he was a person who read and was familiar with the Bible. The scripture also mentions that Ezra was determined to do three things:

 立定心志研究神的话；也就是我们全人性原则所说的知道。  立定心志遵行神的话；也就是全人性原则所说的活道。

   Set your mind to study the Word of God; that is what our whole human principle calls knowing.    Make up your mind to obey God’s word; this is what the principle of total humanity calls the living Word.

 立定心志教导神的话；也就是全人性原则所说的行道。

   Be determined to teach God’s word; this is what the principle of whole humanity calls practicing the word.

以斯拉在开始教导工作之前，已经定志考究和遵行神的话语；这是他所作的适当预备，也是他的良好基础。他在开始事工之前，已经定志于神的话语，也定志于认识那位启示这些话语的神。定志考究圣经和顺服神，是他美好事工的基础。

Before Ezra began his teaching work, he had already committed himself to studying and obeying God's Word. This was proper preparation and a good foundation for his ministry. Before he began his ministry, he had already committed himself to God's Word and to knowing the God who revealed it. This commitment to studying the Scriptures and obeying God was the foundation of his wonderful ministry.

今天我们也一样，我们必须定志于神的话语，好明白和遵行。这是我们有果效的事工的良好根基。我们若想帮助信徒成为神圣洁的子民，就要跟随以斯拉的榜样，先从自己做起：定志研读神的话和遵行神的话，然后把神的旨意和圣经的真理教导弟兄姊妹。

The same is true for us today. We must be determined to understand and obey God's Word. This is a sound foundation for effective ministry. If we want to help believers become God's holy people, we must follow Ezra's example and start with ourselves: be determined to study and obey God's Word, and then teach our brothers and sisters God's will and the truths of the Bible.

有什么可以帮助弟兄姊妹在这个混乱的世代确立我们神圣民、基督徒的身份，在与世界接轨，不离地的同时，也要持守、宣示我们基督徒的身份？我们要帮助他们立定心志研读神的话、遵行神的话和教导神的话。

What can help brothers and sisters establish their identity as divine people and Christians in this chaotic age? While connecting with the world and staying grounded, we must also uphold and proclaim our Christian identity. We must help them resolve to study God's word, obey God's word, and teach God's word.

二、重建圣民  II. Rebuilding the Holy People

拉 9:1~2 这事做完了，众首领来见我，说：以色列民和祭司并利未人，没有离绝迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、亚扪人、摩押人、埃及人、亚摩利人，仍效法这些国的民，行可憎的事。2 因他们为自己和儿子娶了这些外邦女子为妻，以致圣洁的种类和这些国的民混杂；而且首领和官长在这事上为罪魁。

Ezra 9:1-2 When this was done, the leaders came to me and said, "The Israelites, the priests, and the Levites have not separated themselves from the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites, but have followed the abominations of these peoples. 2 They have taken foreign wives for themselves and their sons, so that the holy offspring have mingled with the people of these nations. The leaders and officials are the worst offenders in this matter."

为何我们说以斯拉第二次回归的工作是重建圣民？圣洁的意思是分别出来，被神所用。那么，当时回归的犹大人有什么问题，以致要重建他们神圣民的身份呢？以斯拉记 9 章 1 节提到以色列民“没有离绝……”，“离绝”在原文的意思是分

Why do we say that Ezra's work in the second return was to rebuild the holy people? Holiness means to be set apart and used by God. So, what problems did the returning Jews have that led them to rebuild their identity as God's holy people? Ezra 9 Chapter 1 The verse says that the Israelites “ did not separate …” The word “ separate ” in the original language means to separate

开，如同神把光暗分开了。他们没有跟那些外邦人分开，仍效法他们，行可憎的事。

They did not separate themselves from the Gentiles, but continued to imitate them and practice their abominations.

经文并没有指出是什么事，但可以肯定他们效法他们做一些神所憎恶的事情，例如：拜他们妻子的偶像。

The text does not specify what they were, but it is certain that they imitated them and did things that were abominable to God, such as worshiping their wives’ idols.

以斯拉知道后，就为他们感到难过，因为他们得罪了神。于是，他代他们向神认罪。之后，他就公开指斥这样的罪，吩咐犯了这样罪的人要离绝这些国的民和外邦的女子。

When Ezra learned of this, he felt sorry for them because they had sinned against God. He confessed their sin to God on their behalf. He then publicly condemned this sin and commanded those who committed it to stay away from the people of these nations and foreign women.

我们要留意：当时跟外邦女子结婚的总人数只有 113 人（参拉 10 章），而当时

We should note that the total number of people who married foreign women at that time was only 113 ( see Ezra 10 , and

的总家庭数目约为 2 万，比例不足百分之一。然而，少于百分之一的混杂都不可以。教会也好，我们也好，必须从这个世界错误的价值观、人生观、婚姻观、金钱观等，完完全全分别出来，这样才算是分别为圣；即使只有百分之一的混杂，也不可以。因此，我们必须读圣经，遵守圣经，并且教导圣经，让圣经的真理成为我们和弟兄姊妹的指引，带领整个教会在成圣的路上走。

The total number of families in the world is approximately 20,000 , representing less than 1 percent. However, even less than 1 percent of this mixture is unacceptable. The church and we must completely separate ourselves from the world's erroneous values, outlooks on life, marriage, and money. Only then can we be considered holy. Even a mere 1 percent of this mixture is unacceptable. Therefore, we must read the Bible, obey the Bible, and teach the Bible, allowing its truth to guide us and our brothers and sisters, leading the entire church on the path of sanctification.

 

 

第 99 步  尼希米

Step 99​   Nehemiah

动作：指着第三只手指  

Action: Pointing the third finger

右手仍然竖起三个手指头，左手指着第三只手指，说：“尼希米”。

With three fingers still raised on his right hand, he pointed to the third finger with his left hand and said, " Nehemiah . "

年份：主前 444 年  中国历史：战国时代

Year: BC 444 Year   Chinese History: The Warring States Period

 

经文：  Scripture:

尼 1:3~4   他们对我说：那些被掳归回剩下的人在犹大省遭大难，受凌辱；并且耶路撒冷的城墙拆毁，城门被火焚烧。4 我听见这话，就坐下哭泣，悲哀几日，在天上的神面前禁食祈祷。

Nehemiah 1:3-4 They told me, “The remnant of the captives in the province of Judah are in great distress and are being treated with disgrace; the wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.” 4 When I heard this, I sat down and wept. I mourned for several days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.

尼 6:15~16   以禄月二十五日，城墙修完了，共修了五十二天。16 我们一切仇敌、四围的外邦人听见了便惧怕，愁眉不展；因为见这工作完成是出乎我们的神。

Nehemiah 6:15-16 The wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, having been built in fifty-two days. 16 When all our enemies heard about it, and all the foreigners around us, they were afraid and looked down upon, because they realized that this work had been done with the help of our God.

 

问题：  question:

 尼希米听闻耶路撒冷的最新情况后，有什么反应？

   15. How did Nehemiah react to hearing the latest news about the situation in Jerusalem?

  修建城墙工程共花了多少天？

   How many days did it take to build the city wall?

 

解释：  explain:

一、尼希米的背景  1. Nehemiah’s Background

领导最后一个阶段回归的人，是波斯王的酒政尼希米（参尼 1:11）。什么是酒政？酒政不单要为王试酒，还要陪王帝饮酒谈心，因此，是一个深得王信任的重臣。虽然他身在波斯的首都书珊，却心系耶路撒冷。听到同胞在犹大省被欺凌，耶路撒冷的城墙被拆毁，他就坐下哭泣，悲哀了好几天，并且在神面前禁食祷告。由于他是波斯王的近臣，波斯王看出他面有愁容，就问他心中有什么愁烦。尼希米向神默祷，并且向王提出要回归，重新建造刚被火烧毁的城墙。波斯王不单允准他的要求，更给他材料，并且派军兵护送他回去。

The person who led the final stage of the return was Nehemiah, the cupbearer of the king of Persia ( see Nehemiah 1:11 . What was a cupbearer? Not only did the cupbearer have to taste the king’s wine, but he also had to drink and talk with the king. Therefore, he was a trusted official. Although he was in Shushan, the capital of Persia, his heart was with Jerusalem. When he heard that his compatriots were being bullied in the province of Judah and that the walls of Jerusalem had been demolished, he sat down and wept, mourning for several days and fasting and praying before God. Since he was a close official of the Persian king, the king saw that he had a sad face and asked him what was bothering him. Nehemiah prayed silently to God and asked the king to return to rebuild the city wall that had just been burned down. The Persian king not only agreed to his request but also provided him with materials and sent soldiers to escort him back.

他领导第三次的回归，并领导重建城墙的工作。纵使困难重重，又要面对敌对的势力，但神施恩给他，使他用了短短 52 日，就成功带领百姓修好耶路撒冷的城墙。他是一位既敬虔又有领导能力的领袖。

He led the third return and the rebuilding of the city wall. Despite facing numerous difficulties and hostile forces, God showed him favor, enabling him to successfully lead the people in repairing Jerusalem's wall in just 52 days. He was a leader who was both godly and capable.

二、重建城墙的意义  2. The significance of rebuilding the city wall

重建圣殿的意义等同重建跟神的关系；重建圣民的意义等同重建神子民的身份和行事为人的标准；那重建城墙又有什么意义？

The significance of rebuilding the temple is equivalent to rebuilding the relationship with God; the significance of rebuilding the holy people is equivalent to rebuilding the identity and standards of conduct of God's people; then what is the significance of rebuilding the city wall?

 神是他们真正的保护：连外邦人也知道这工作是出乎神的手（参尼 6:16）。昔日他们以为有圣殿、耶路撒冷城就等于有保护，然而，现在他们深深体会到神才是他们的保护；若不是神施恩，尼希米岂能回归？若不是神坚固他们的手，他们又焉能在短短 52 天内，把城墙重建起来？

 God was their true protector: Even the Gentiles knew that this work was the work of God ( see Nehemiah 6:16 ) . In the past, they thought that the temple and the city of Jerusalem were their protection. However, now they deeply understood that God was their true protector. Without God's grace, how could Nehemiah have returned? Without God's strengthening of their hands, how could they have rebuilt the city wall in just 52 days?

 与四周的人分别出来：城墙成为一道界线，把犹大人从四围的外邦人分别出来。既然他们是属神的子民，而四周的外邦人在耶路撒冷无分、无权、无记念，犹大人就该再次珍惜自己神子民的独特身份。

   Separated from the surrounding people: The city wall became a boundary, separating the Jews from the surrounding Gentiles. Since they were God's people, and the surrounding Gentiles had no share, no rights, and no remembrance in Jerusalem, the Jews should once again cherish their unique identity as God's people.

 没有破口让仇敌乘虚而入：关于修造城墙的分工安排，尼希米记第 3 章重复提到有好些人对着自己的房屋修造（尼 3:10、23、28、29、30），也就是说，他们让自己所处的地方不成为破口。每个人起码要做的就是不让自己那儿成为一个破口。当整个城墙修建好，没有半点破口，敌人就没法乘虚而入。

   No gaps for the enemy to exploit: Regarding the division of labor in building the city wall, Nehemiah 3 repeatedly mentions that many people built opposite their own houses ( Nehemiah 3:10 , 23 , 28 , 29 , 30 ). In other words, they made sure that their own areas would not become gaps. The least everyone had to do was to prevent their own areas from becoming gaps. When the entire wall was built, without any gaps, the enemy would not be able to exploit them to enter.

今天，教会需要什么？是宏伟的教堂吗？是金钱吗？教会最需要和不可缺的就是神的同在；教会需要重寻圣洁，跟世俗分别出来；每个弟兄姊妹需要检视自己的生活，填补一切属灵的缺口──一切让自己失去圣洁和神的同在的缺口，一切让魔鬼有机可乘的缺口。

What does the church need today? Is it a grand building? Is it money? What the church needs most, what it cannot do without, is God's presence. The church needs to rediscover holiness and separate itself from the world. Every brother and sister needs to examine their own lives and fill any spiritual gaps — all gaps that deprive them of holiness and God's presence, all gaps that allow the devil to exploit.

三、尼希米的特点  3. Characteristics of Nehemiah

不少人都认为尼希米是一个出色的领袖和管理者，因此，从他所作的学习他的领导和管理技巧。尼希诚然是一位出色的领袖和管理者，但他生命最重要的特质是祈祷。他常常一边工作，一边向神发出很短的祷告。尼希米记的开始是他禁食祷告，而结束也是关乎他的祷告。尼希米记多次记载尼希米的短祷：

Many people consider Nehemiah an outstanding leader and manager, and therefore, learn from his leadership and management skills. While Nehemiah was undoubtedly an outstanding leader and manager, his most important characteristic was prayer. He often offered short prayers to God while working. The book of Nehemiah begins with his fasting and prayer, and also ends with his prayer. The book of Nehemiah records several of Nehemiah's short prayers:

尼 1:4    在天上的神面前禁食祷告……

Ni 1:4     Fast and pray before the God in heaven ...

尼 2:4    默祷天上的神……

Ni 2:4     Silently pray to God in heaven ...

尼 5:19   我的神啊，求你记念我为这百姓所行的一切的事，施恩于我……

Ni 5:19    Remember, O my God, all that I have done for this people, and show me favor …

尼 6:9    神啊，求你坚固我的手……

Ni 6:9     God, please strengthen my hands ...

尼 6:14   我的神啊…求你记念他们所行的这些事……

Ni 6:14    My God , please remember what they did .

尼 13:14   我的神啊，求你因这事记念我……

Ni 13:14    My God, please remember me about this ...

尼 13:22   我的神啊，求你因这事记念我，照你的大慈爱怜恤我……

Ni 13:22    Please remember me for this, O my God, and have mercy on me according to the greatness of your lovingkindness …

尼 13:30   我的神啊，求你记念我，施恩于我。

Ni 13:30    My God, please remember me and be gracious to me .

因此，我们不要把与神相交的时间局限在灵修时段。要学习不住地祷告，随时随地多方祷告祈求，即使一句两句也好。不要忘记，每一次祷告都是与神相遇的时刻。

Therefore, we should not limit our time with God to quiet time. We should learn to pray unceasingly, praying in many ways at all times and in all places, even if it is just a few words. Never forget that every moment of prayer is a moment of encounter with God .

此外，从尼希米的生平，我们还可以留意到他的其他特质：

In addition, we can observe other qualities of Nehemiah from his life:

 

有荣耀神的热心（参尼 1:4）

Have a zeal to glorify God ( see Nehemiah 1:4 )

 

作无私的奉献（参尼 2:1~7）

Make selfless contributions ( see Nehemiah 2:1-7 )

 

能订立明智的计划（参尼 2:4~7）

Able to make wise plans ( see Nehemiah 2:4-7 )

 

能传递异象感染他人（参尼 2:17~18， 4:1~14）

Able to convey vision and infect others ( see Nehemiah 2:17-18 , 4:1-14 )

 

过公义的生活（参尼 5:1~13）

Live a righteous life ( see Nehemiah 5:1-13 )

 

以教导为事奉（参尼 8:9、18）

Teaching as a ministry ( see Nehemiah 8:9 , 18 )

 

憎恨罪恶（参尼 13:25）

Hate sin ( see Nehemiah 13:25 )

 

你能找出尼希米的其他特质吗？  Can you identify other qualities of Nehemiah?

 

 

第 100 步  沉默 400 年

Step 100​   400 years of silence

动作：四只手指盖嘴巴，再反过来向前推送  

Action: Cover your mouth with four fingers and push forward

这一步的动作有两部分：（1）竖起四只手指，盖住嘴巴，说：“沉默”。（2）然后把这四只手指反过来，掌心向外，向前推送出去，并说：“400 年”。

This step has two parts: ( 1 ) Hold up four fingers, cover your mouth, and say: " Silence . " ( 2 ) Then turn the four fingers over, palms facing outward, push them forward, and say: " 400 years . "

年份：主前 400 年~主后 1 年  中国历史：战国时代、秦朝、汉朝（初年）

Year: BC 400 Year ~ AD 1 Year   Chinese History: Warring States Period, Qin Dynasty, Han Dynasty (early years )

 

经文：  Scripture:

加 4:4    及至时候满足，神就差遣他的儿子，为女子所生，且生在律法以下。

add 4:4     But when the fullness of the time had come, God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under the law .

来 1:1~2   神既在古时借着众先知多次多方的晓谕列祖，2 就在这末世借着他儿子晓谕我们；……

Hebrews 1:1-2 God, who in time past spoke to our fathers by the prophets at various times and in various ways, 2 has in these last days spoken to us by his Son .

约 1:14   道成了肉身，住在我们中间，充充满满的有恩典有真理。

about 1:14    The Word became flesh and dwelt among us, full of grace and truth .

 

问题：  question:

 根据希伯来书 1 章 1 至 2 节，神在这末世借谁向人说话？

   According to Hebrews 1 : 1-2 , through whom does God speak to mankind in these last days?

 

解释：  explain:

先知玛拉基约于主前 400 年写玛拉基书，自此之后，有一段很长的时间神的话语再没有临到以色列人；因此，这段时期称为“沉默的时期”。

The prophet Malachi about 400 BC The book of Malachi was written in 1626. After that, there was a long period of time when God’s word did not come to the Israelites; therefore, this period is called the “ Time of Silence . ”

在这 400 年的沉默时期中，很多事情发生了；有些事情是预言的直接应验，有些则为弥赛亚的降临预备世人。要知道这段时期的详情，请看《新约精览（一）》。凡此种种都使以色列人热切期盼弥赛亚的来临，热切期盼一位大有能力的君王来到，解开他们的枷锁，并在地上建立神的国度。

In this 400 During this period of silence, many events occurred; some were direct fulfillments of prophecy, while others prepared the world for the coming of the Messiah. For details about this period, see "New Testament Overview (Part 1)." All of this fueled the Israelites' eager anticipation for the coming of the Messiah, a powerful King who would free them from their bonds and establish God's Kingdom on earth.

当时机成熟，神打破 400 年来的沉默，通过加利利一名贫家童女，让基督降生

When the time was right, God broke his 400- year silence and brought Christ to life through a poor virgin from Galilee.

在伯利恒城。隔了 400 年，神终于差遣自己的儿子来说话了，这是神与人最高层次的沟通。这一次，神不再通过先知向人说话，而是亲自来到人世间，住在人中间，直接向人说话。虽然他是从天来到地上，从富足变为贫穷，要夸过神与人之间那么大的文化、生活障碍，然而他没有半丁点抱怨。因为圣经说，道成了肉身，住在人中间，充充满满的有恩典和真理；他不是高高在上（他当然绝对高高在上，也可以高高在上），他俯就我们这些卑微的人，在一个籍籍无名的穷乡僻壤长大，亲身体验人生活的艰难和困苦……。我们只能在《新约精览（一）》详细交代。

In Bethlehem. 400 In 1694, God finally sent His Son to speak, marking the highest level of communication between God and humanity. This time, God no longer spoke through prophets, but personally descended into the human world, dwelt among them, and spoke directly to them. Although He descended from heaven to earth, rising from wealth to poverty, and overcoming the vast cultural and life barriers between God and humanity, He did not complain at all. The Bible says that the Word became flesh and dwelt among men, full of grace and truth. He was not high and mighty (of course He absolutely was, and could have been), but He condescended to us humble people, growing up in an obscure, remote village, and experiencing firsthand the hardships and difficulties of human life ... We can only explore this in detail in "New Testament Insights (Part 1 )."

92.波斯帝國興起

Rise of Persian Kingdom

Go to Persian, two hand rise up to shoulder’s level

92. Sự trỗi dậy của Đế quốc Ba Tư

Đi đến Ba-tư và từ từ giơ tay lên đến vai

 

 

解釋：

波斯帝國的興起是這地區最大的政治轉變。全盛時期的波斯帝國，西起希臘，東至印度。波斯帝國位於巴比倫東北面，首都是書珊；這時巴比倫帝國已經明顯衰落。

在古列王統治下，波斯人先征服瑪代，下一個目標是巴比倫……

 

 “外邦人的日期”  Ngày của dân ngoại là nghịch ngợm

 

新约圣经对“外邦人的富足”、“外邦人的数目”和“外邦人的日期”都加以区别. 马唐纳(Wm. MacDonald)在《活石新约圣经注释》中解释:

  1. 外邦人的富足(The Riches of the Gentiles, 罗11:12): 指外邦人因以色列被神暂时撇在一边(特指在召会时代的情况)而享有的尊荣地位.
  2. 外邦人的数目(The Fulness of the Gentiles, 罗11:25): 指被提的时候, 基督的外邦新妇已完全, 从地上被接去, 而神恢复祂与以色列的交往或关系(dealings, 即恢复神给以色列的计划, 实现神给他们的应许).
  3. 外邦人的日期(The Times of the Gentiles, 路21:24): 真正始于以色列人被巴比伦俘虏, 一直延续至外邦不再控制耶路撒冷的日子(即主耶稣第二次再来摧毁敌对神的外邦政权).【注: “外邦人的日期”主要是强调耶路撒冷被外邦管治, 但这并不表示犹太人不能拥有短暂时期对耶路撒冷的控制 (如现今的情况); “外邦人日期满了”是指耶路撒冷不再受到外邦的入侵或干扰, 那是要等到基督第二次再临才实现】

解釋：

我們知道猶大百姓分三個階段被擄到巴比倫（參第86 至89 步）。他們回歸以色列也同樣分三個階段。神把百姓帶到異地，現在祂要把他們帶回來。每個階段都有一位領袖帶領百姓回歸。

請記住，要一個人悔改，向神回轉，是比較容易的；但要一群人、一個教會，以至多個教會一同悔改，便往往需要有人帶領。要引領他們歸回天父，必須要有領袖；你能夠帶領會眾悔改和向神回轉嗎？

以下是三位帶領餘民回到耶路撒冷重建聖殿和城牆，並使他們復興的領袖：

100.沉默 400年      400 years of silent      100. 400 năm im lặng

 

100.沉默 400年

400 years of silent

Put 4 fingers before the mouth, then turn 4 finger back in front of the mouth

100. 400 năm im lặng

Che miệng bằng bốn ngón tay, rồi lật lòng bàn tay lại đẩy về phía trước

赛 Isa Ê-sai  53:1-11

诗 Psm  22

 

解釋：

先知瑪拉基約於主前 400 年寫瑪拉基書，自此之後，神的話語有一段很長的時間沒有再臨到；因此，這段時期稱為“沈默的時期”。在這400 年的沈默時期中，很多事情發生了；有些事情是預言的直接應驗，有些則為彌賽亞的降臨預備世人。要知道這段時期的詳情，請看《新約精覽（一）》。尼希米那一代人死去之後約 100 年，希臘帝國征服了波斯。這支希臘軍隊行動異常迅速，接二連三攻佔了多個地區，速度之快令人難以置信。但當帝國元首亞歷山大大帝一死，帝國便四分五裂。其中一名將軍取了埃及和附近地區，另一名將軍則取了以色列以北的地區。由於這兩派之間常有戰爭，處於兩地中間的以色列常常成了戰場。

 

有一段時期，當北方的將領控制以色列時，他們以高壓手段強迫以色列人接受希臘的文化和宗教。這些壓力慢慢凝聚，終於在主前168 年達到高峰。當時有一個王褻瀆耶路撒冷的聖殿，在祭壇獻豬，宣稱那殿是一個希臘神祇的廟宇，也就是“設立那行毀壞可憎的”（參但11:31 的預言）。結果希伯來人發動叛亂，並取得勝利。雖然以色列得以暫時獨立，但國家實際上是一團糟：領袖毫不敬虔，高層的祭司腐敗。這時候，另一個帝國興起了，那就是羅馬帝國。羅馬帝國建立了有史以來最強大的軍隊，輕而易舉地征服了希臘，也佔領了以色列。

 

這些事情使以色列人熱切期待彌賽亞到來。百姓萬分期望一位大有能力的君王到來，解開他們的枷鎖，並在地上建立神的國度，這是他們全民的期盼。他們強調以賽亞書9 章6 節、7 章14 節和撒迦利亞書14 章4 至11 節等經文，滿心盼望彌賽亞滿有榮耀和能力地從雲彩降臨。但他們卻有意忽略以賽亞書53 章1 至11 節、詩篇22 篇和撒迦利亞書12 章10 節等經文；這些經文講到彌賽亞要來作僕人，且要被人嘲笑、拒絕、毆打和殺害。他們不想要這樣的彌賽亞。

但在適當的時間，神打破 400 年來的沈默，通過天使向加利利海某小鎮一名貧家童女說話。結果就如這天使所說的，基督在伯利恒城降生了。隔了400 年，神終於說話了；祂差遣自己的兒子來宣揚祂，這是神與人最高層次的溝通。

3. Storytelling: through Vivid Stories Underst and inghistorical events

4. Group Discussion: Learn and review with partners

5. Practice Application: historical lessons Application to Real Life
